(nga )༄༅/ /rta mchog rol pa gsang sgrub kyi bsnyen thabs yi ge'i rnga gsang zhes bya ba bzhugs/ /na mo ha yot+ta ma la li tā ya/dpal ldan shangs pa'i gsang sgra

tei:div.tei:p: (nga )༄༅// rta mchog rol pa gsang sgrub kyi bsnyen thabs yi ge'i rnga gsang zhes bya ba bzhugs// na mo ha yot+ta ma la li tā ya/ dpal ldan shangs pa'i gsang sgrub skor gsum gyi// nang gses rta mchog rol pa bsnyen pa'i thabs// som nyi'i mal du yur ba'i rig sngags 'chang*// sad byed yi ge'i rnga gsang 'bum du ldir// 'dir rta mchog rol pa gsang sgrub ces bya ba dpal ldan shangs par brgyud pa rin chen sna bdun du grags pa'i brgyud pa lnga pa dbon ston skyer sgang pa chen pos mnal lam bzung nas au ḍ+yān dpal ri pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas su byon nas slob dpon chen po pad+ma sam+bha wa dpal rta mgrin gyi skur bzhengs pa las dbang bskur ba gsan cing*/ de nyid nas lung bstan stsal ba ltar phyis snye mo rgya gong ri pa sangs rgyas dbang chen gyis gter nas spyan drangs pa'ang gsan pas bka' gter zung 'jug tu gyur pa 'di ni/ spyir lha srin sde brgyad dang khyad par rgyal gdon gyi gnyen por che zhing zab par grags pa 'di'i bsnyen pa ji ltar bya ba'i tshul ni/ gter gzhung dang mthun pa spyi 'gros sbyar ba'i sngon 'gro skyabs sems dang*/ spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol mchod 'bul sogs dkyus su mi gsal ba rnams rat+na gling pa'i rta mgrin gsang 'dus nas kha 'gengs par mdzad pa'i yig cha rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos mdzad pa de ltar mos pa dag gis yig cha de nyid du gzigs pas gsal zhing*/ 'dir ni tshar chen rin po che dang mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i yi ge gsar ma'i 'gros sbyar gyi phyag len deng sang kun gyis nyams su bzhes byar mchis pa de'i lugs kyi bsnyen pa bya ba'i tshul ni/ gza' skar dus tshes bzang ba'i nyin/ gnas khang dben par rgyan gyis brgyan par 'di'i sku brnyan bris 'bur gang rung bshams pa'i mdun du/ stegs bu'am shing sgam la sogs pa byi ba sogs kyis mi gnod par byas pa'i gzhi la/

gtor ma snying gzugs rgyan ldan dang chu gnyis nyer spyod sbreng tshar du bsham/ rang gi mdun du nang mchod rdo rje dril bu me tog bcas dang*/ nub dang po'i sngon 'gro'i cha gsum gyi chas dang yungs thun rnams ma tshang ba med par bya'o// rang nyid gdan la 'khod cing*/ cha gsum gtor ma bran pa spyi ltar btang nas bgegs gtor gyi rjes la bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags dang*/ sum+bha ni dang rta mgrin gyi sngags brjod cing dril bu'i sgra bsgrags/ gu gul gyis bdug cing yungs kar gyis thun brdeg sems kyi dmigs pa ni/ rang nyid rta mgrin gyi skur gsal ba'i sku las khro bo'i tshogs lag na mtshon cha thogs pa grangs med pa phyogs mtshams kun tu khyab par 'phros pas byang chub sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad pa'i las mdzad/ slar yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs mtshams steng 'og thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi rwa ba dang gur sa zhing brtan pa/ phyi rol nas ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā lan gsum brjod pas brtan par bya'o// 'di nas brtsams te mtshams kyi nang du 'jug dgos kyi rigs gang yod dmigs 'og tu chud pa 'di dang 'di'o zhes nges par bya/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ thog mar mdun gyi nang mchod sngar kye rdor sogs kyi nang mchod bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs pa yin na mi dgos la/ gsar pa yin na bla med gang rung gis byin rlabs cho ga spyi ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod nas 'thor tshul dang*/ ngag tu/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las aḥlas byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon zhabs bsil/

me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar dang ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi sogs lan gsum dang bcas pas byin dbab bo// de nas skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ rang gang du gnas pa'i sa gzhi yangs shing rgya che ba snyoms shing yid du 'ong ba bde chen pad+ma 'od kyi zhing gi yon tan dang ldan pa'i dbus su rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar rin po che'i khri pad+ma nyi ma brtsegs pa'i steng du rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang bskur byin rlabs khrid dang gdams ngag dang khyad par tshul 'di'i byin rlabs gdams pa rjes su 'doms pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo yin pa la rnam pa dpal rta mgrin gyi skur gsal gdab/ de la brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor nas bzhugs par bsams pa ni skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul yin/ rang gi g.yas g.yon du pha ma dang mdun du rang gi tshe rabs du ma'i gnod byed kyi gdon bgegs 'byung po dgra 'dre rnams kyis thog drangs pa'i rigs drug bar dor bcas pa'i sems can thams cad khrom chen po tshogs pa ltar 'khod par bsams pa ni skyabs su 'gro ba rnams yin/ dus deng nas bzung ste sangs rgyas ma thob bar du skyabs gnas su gzung snyam du rang gis skyabs 'gro byed pa bzhin/ de thams cad kyis kyang skyabs 'gro byed pa'i sgra 'ur dir yod par bsam/ de la'ang bla ma zhes pa'i tshe gtso bo bla ma/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang bcas pa la sems gtad/ sangs rgyas zhes pa'i tshe bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas thams cad la sems gtad/ dam pa'i chos zhes pa'i tshe de rnams kyi thugs rgyud kyi spangs rtogs kyi yon tan dang*/ khyad par bla ma dang yi dam rta mgrin dbyer med pa'i gsung sngags kyi snying po'i rnam par shar ba rnams chos yin pas de la sems gtad/

dge 'dun zhes pa'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs thams cad la sems gtad pa'i ngang nas/ bdag dang 'gro ba sogs kyis skyabs 'gro ci nus bya/ de nas bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas de thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang dang sems can thams cad la thim pas/ dkon mchog gi byin rlabs zhugs nas de thams cad lus zag med 'ja' lus dang sems rtog med chos kyi sku thob nas sangs rgyas song snyam pa bya'o// sems bskyed ni/ rigs drug sems can thams cad rang gi skye ba nas skye bar pha ma phu nur ma gyur pa gcig kyang med pas 'di rnams drin che snyam du bsgom/ drin che snyam nas bzhag pas phan pa mi 'dug pas 'di rnams sdug bsngal las bsgral nas sangs rgyas kyi sa la bzhag dgos pa 'dug mod/ da lta ni bdag la nus pa med pas bdag sangs rgyas thob par gyur na skad cig re re la'ang sems can dpag tu med pa dngos dang brgyud nas sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god nus pa 'dug pas/ 'di rnams kyi don du bdag sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'ang rang gar bsdad pas thob mi nus pa 'dug pas/ da lan yi dam gyi bsgom bzlas zab mo 'di nyams su blangs na/ sngon gyi grub thob mang pos sangs rgyas thob song ba de bzhin du bdag gis cis kyang 'tshang rgya nges pa zhig bya snyam pas/ ngag tu/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o zhes lan gsum sogs brjod/ 'di dag snying thag pa nas nyams su blangs pas rang rgyud kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa gsum gong 'phel du 'gyur ba dang*/ nyams pa sor chud par 'gyur ba'i thabs su 'gyur ba yin te de yan chad kyis sgrub thabs kyi sngon 'gro bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa bstan nas/ ye shes kyi tshogs bsag pa ni/

snod bcud 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang gi sems kyi snang ba rmi lam lta bu/ de'ang rang rig pa sgyu ma lta bu/ de'ang rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du shes par byas nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsar+b+ba dhar+m+māḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes pa'i sngags don ni/ mchog ster rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis dag pa nga'o zhes rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i bdag nyid can de la nga'o zhes pa'i tha snyad byas pa'o// sgrub thabs kyi dngos gzhi la gnyis las/ dang po lha bsgom pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum mthing nag yangs shing rgya che ba rtsa ba phra ba thur du bstan pa/ gdengs kha che ba gyen du bstan pa zur gcig mdun phyogs dang*/ zur gnyis rgyab phyogs kyi g.yas g.yon du bstan pa/ phyi rol nas ye shes kyi me kha dog sna lnga 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa/ de'i nang stong pa nam mkha'i rang bzhin du gyur pa'i dbus su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du rang gi sems nyid hrīḥdamar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ bdag dang sems can thams cad byang chub sgrub pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i gnod byed kyi gdon bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ 'od zer tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim zhing yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa zhes pa nas ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa zhes pa'i bar gyi zhal phyag rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba lta bu'i skur gsal gdab/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ de la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod pas rang la thim par bsam mo// de nas 'di ltar bsam par bya ste/

bdag ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung las sprul pa'i spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug nyid srid pa gsum gyi lha srin sde brgyad dang rgyal gdon 'byung po ma rungs pa thams cad btul nas/ mthar thug de dag thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god pa'i gnyen por sprul pa'i dpal rta mgrin de nga yin no snyam du nga rgyal la ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag yang de lta bu'i rta mchog rol pa'i sku de yang zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i rnam pa 'di ltar yin snyam du cung zad dran par bya'o// de ni bskyed rim lha bsgom pa'i rim pa'o// gnyis pa sngags bzla ba ni/ rang nyid rta mchog rol par gsal ba'i zhal dang*/ rang gi mgrin pa nas brtsams te zhabs kyi long bu'i bar gyi ba spu'i bu ga thams cad khro chung gis gtams pa'i khro chung gi tshogs dang bcas pa'i lha thams cad kyi zhal nas sngags kyi sgra 'brug stong dus gcig tu ldir ba ltar sgrogs pa dang*/ sku'i cha thams cad dang zhal nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams thams cad khyab/ 'od zer gyi rtse mo nas me tog la sogs pa nyer spyod dang gzugs sogs 'dod pa'i yon tan dpag tu med pa spros nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs thams cad mchod pas mnyes par byas/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang sdug bsngal thams cad sbyangs/ khyad par lhag pa'i lha 'di nyid kyi gdul byar gyur pa'i lha srin sde brgyad spyi dang khyad par rgyal 'gong 'byung po rnams la 'od zer phog pa dang sngags kyi sgra thos pa tsam gyis zhe sdang dang gdug pa'i bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad zhi/ byams snying rje dang byang chub kyi sems rgyud la skyes nas/ chos sgrub pa rnams kyi stong grogs dang dpung gnyen byed pa'i las can du gyur/ 'od zer tshur 'dus pa dang mnyam du sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer kha dog lnga'i rnam par spyan drangs nas rang la thim pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin rlabs nus pa dang mnyam par bsams la/

oṃ hrīḥpad+man+ta ta kṛta badz+ra kro ta ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa thun re la ci nus bzla/ thun gyi mthar rtsa sngags gsham du dbang du bsdu ba'i sngags/ oṃ badz+ra dun bh+yo/ trig nas dzaḥdzaḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ las sngags ni/ sa ma ya dzaḥ sa ma ya bzlog sa ma ya bh+yo/ sa ma ya gtubs/ sa ma ya byer/ sa ma ya rbad/ sa ma ya rbad rbud phaṭa ya/ 'byung po mā ra ya dzaḥdzaḥzhes btags pa sbrel nas thog mar lan gsum tsam las mang bar mi bzla/ bsnyen pa song nas nyer gcig la sogs pa bzla rung bar gsung*/ de nas bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar gyi gnod pa/ 'og gdon klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa/ bar gdon btsan dang mu dang rgyal 'gong the'u rang gi gnod pa'i nad gdon bgegs sogs bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du dpal rta mchog rol pa'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ gtor bsngo mi byed na/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag rta mchog rol pa 'grub gyur nas sogs bsngo ba smon lam gyi rgyas btab/ gtor bsngo byed na dge ba bsngo ba'i gong der/ gtor ma chab kyis bran la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ mdun bskyed sku rten la dmigs te/ mdun gyi nam mkhar e las chos kyi 'byung gnas mthing nag yangs shing rgya che ba/ phyi rol nas ye shes kyi me dpung kha dog sna lnga 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa'i dbus su nyi ma'i steng du hrīḥdamar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ gnod byed kyi gdon bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/

tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa sku mdog dmar po sogs nas me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas mdun bskyed la thim par bsam/ de la gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ oṃ hrīḥpad+man+ta kṛta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇā pa ya kha kha khā hi khā hi zhes gsum mam lngas phul/ oṃ ha ya grī wa oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ nas shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā'i bar gyis mchod/ spyan ras gzigs sprul hrīḥlas khro bo'i sku// chos rje 'od dpag med pa rdo rje chos// log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs rnams 'dul mdzad pa// rta mgrin rta skad bzhad la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar sogs nas nad gdon bgegs sogs bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi zhing tshar gcad par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa lta bu'i 'dod don gang mos zhus/ oṃ pad+ma satwa sa ma ya zhes sogs pad+ma bzhi sbyor ram/ mi nus na oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya sogs rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa zhes pa nas bzod par mdzod/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i sogs nas su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swā hās sku rten la me tog 'thor zhing brtan bzhugs bya/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag rta mchog rol pa 'grub gyur zhes sogs bsngo ba dang che ba'i che mchog sogs kyis bkra shis brjod do// gtor mgron bsdu na/

rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas khro bo'i rgyal po zhes pa man chad skad cig gis spyan drangs pa nas bkra shis kyi bar sngar ltar brjod pas kyang rung ngo*// des gung thun nam dgongs thun song nas/ yang srod thun la skyabs 'gro nas bzung ste/ bzlas pa'i mjug gi 'dod don gsol gdab kyi rjes su dge ba bsngo ba'i bar tshar gcig nyams su len pa ni srod thun no// sang gi tho rengs nas bzung ste nyi dros bar de lta bu tshar gcig nyams su len pa ni thor thun no// de nas thun gsum las mi byed na/ gung thun gyi gong du mchod gtor kha gsos te mchod pa byin rlabs nas bzung ste gtor bsngo dang 'brel bar tshar gcig nyams su len pa ni gung thun no// gal te thun bzhi byed na thor thun gyi rjes su snga thun dang*/ nyi phyed yol tsam nas dgongs mo'i bar gyi thun te gtor bsngo ni/ snga thun phyi thun gang rung gi mjug tu byed pa ste/ de lta bu'i rim pas rtsa sngags yig 'bru nyi shu pa 'bum phrag bzhi kha skong dang bcas pa bzla ba ni grangs bsnyen gcig yin no// mdor na mnyam gzhag rjes thob thams cad du rang gi lus ngag yid gsum lha sngags ye shes gsum gyi rnam rol du shes pa'i 'dun pa ma bral ba'i ngang nas/ gdon bgegs 'byung po rnams la byams snying rje drag po'i sgo nas las ngan gyi 'phro bcad de phan gdags pa'i sems bskyed kyis gang zin byas te nyams su blangs pas rang gzhan gyi don gnyis lhun grub tu 'byung ba ni som nyi med pa nyid do// smras pa/ pad+ma rā ga'i lhun por 'od brgya pas// 'khyud par log 'dren gzhil ba'i mthu rdzogs na// rta mchog gzugs sku 'bar ba yid lam du// bkod pa'i ngo mtshar rjes su cis mi byed// 'di bris dge tshogs rab mnyen sor mo yis// 'khrul snang 'byung por zhen pa'i rgya nang du// sems kyi gnam 'phyo chud pa yongs bkrol nas// bde legs rgya mtshor ci dgar rtsen gyur cig

/ces rta mchog rol pa gsang sgrub kyi bsnyen thabs yi ge'i rnga gsang zhes bya ba 'di ni/ chos rgyal chen po'i mdun na 'don tshul khrims rab brtan pa'i ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis sug bris su byas pa bkra shis par gyur cig/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
